page.title: Clients
page.description: The browsers, phones, command lines and scripts that may use Ahab. Each has its own credential: revoke one and only it is locked out.

unused.notice_one: {{count}} client hasn't been used for 3 months. Revoke it?
unused.notice_other: {{count}} clients haven't been used for 3 months. Revoke them?

confirm.description: {{names}}. They can no longer reach Ahab; pair them again to use them.

clientPage.notFound: This client is not paired any more.
clientPage.encrypted: Last used over HTTPS, this computer or a tailnet.

via.link: with a pairing link or QR code
via.code: with a code typed on it
via.token: a token for scripts, made by another client

table.notEncryptedHint: Last used over plain HTTP on a network: anyone on it could read what is sent.

revoke.title: Revoke {{name}}?
revoke.description: It can no longer reach Ahab, and its open connections close at once. Pair it again to use it.
revoke.descriptionCurrent: This is the browser you use now: it shows the pairing screen next. Its open connections close at once.
revoke.descriptionLocal: The server writes a new credential file at once; the command line on the server's computer keeps working. Anything that copied the old one stops working.

create.title: Create a token for a script
create.label: What is it for?

token.title: Your new token
token.description: Copy it now: it is not shown again. Send it as {{header}}, or set {{variable}} for the ahab command.

addClient.title: Add a client
addClient.description: Scan the code with the new client, or open the link on it. It works once, for 10 minutes.
addClient.failed: No pairing link can be made: {{message}}
addClient.qrLabel: QR code of the pairing link
addClient.orType: Or open {{origin}} on the new client and type {{code}}.
addClient.waiting: Waiting for the new client, until {{time}}.

prompts.label: Clients asking to be paired
prompts.check: Approve only if the client shows the same code.
prompts.checkOpened: Opened from this client's link or QR code. Approve only if it shows the same code.
prompts.notFound: It was answered already, or expired.

requests.noneWithCode: No client waits with code {{code}}: it may have been answered, or expired.

pairing.title: Your agents, on your machines.
pairing.lead: Pair this browser from a client that's already paired to start.
pairing.onServer: On the server's computer: {{approve}}, or {{open}} to open Ahab there already paired.

problems.pairingInvalid: This code does not work: it may be mistyped, used or expired.
problems.tooManyAttempts: Too many tries from here. Wait a minute, then try again.
problems.insecureConnection: This connection is plain HTTP from a public address, so Ahab does not pair over it. Reach Ahab over HTTPS, a VPN or your home network.

problems.expired: This link was used already or expired. Ask for a new one with Add client.
problems.invalid: This link does not work. Ask for a new one with Add client.
problems.noSecret: This link has no pairing secret. Ask for a new one with Add client.
